recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Treat FHIR-3702 as historically applied and superseded; no current core source fix is needed for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-3702 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request to rename Encounter.subject to Encounter.patient because Encounter.subject then only allowed Patient. Jira records the issue as pre-applied with the element updated to patient.
initial_application: Historical commit 1b5840ba77 explicitly listed tracker 3702 and changed Encounter examples from <subject> to <patient> while updating the Encounter spreadsheet, showing the DSTU1 request was applied at the time.
additional_context: FHIR-12630 directly superseded the seed by deciding that Encounter.patient should be renamed back to Encounter.subject, the datatype should allow Reference(Patient|Group), and the patient search parameter should remain while selecting only Patient references. FHIR-20479 later clarified that Encounter.subject can be related to an encounter even when the patient is not present, FHIR-21770 clarified that the patient search parameter should mention only Patient behavior, and FHIR-34100 kept Patient/Group as Encounter subject-related concepts with constraints.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative source defines Encounter.subject with Patient and Group targets, keeps patient as an alias, and provides Encounter-patient over Encounter.subject.where(resolve() is Patient). Renaming the element back to Encounter.patient would undo later final PA decisions.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive decision renamed Encounter.patient back to Encounter.subject and allowed Patient or Group.

Preserved Patient/Group as Encounter subject-related actors while adding participant guardrails.
